operator_observation: Dave reported that all Studio projects appear frozen and progress is not reflected in the apps.

audit_result.summary: Most Studio project records had only one event, and that event was project_seeded or project_created. The Projects page was showing backlog intent and seeded progress estimates, not actual implementation movement.
examples: Studio Projects Table Organization had 1 event: project_seeded.
LAB Workbench Servo Tester had 1 event: project_created, despite later Codex/firmware work occurring outside the project event ledger.
AgentMIM repair projects had 1 event each: project_seeded.
MIM Robotics Workspace, AgentMIM Account Manager, and MIM Accounting had no project events.

root_cause: Studio Projects did not yet have a follow-through/reconciliation layer that binds actual work evidence, Codex commits, TOD execution, MIM decisions, and operator changes back into project events.
fix: Add event-backed movement state to Project rows: frozen, seed only, moving, blocked, or waiting Dave.
Add event counts and last-event age to the Project Inbox table.
Make Active/In Process count stricter so it no longer means every non-deleted project.
Treat project_audit events as non-movement so audits do not falsely advance a project.

required_next_objective.goal: Connect Studio project records to actual evidence streams so work cannot happen outside the project ledger.
minimum_behavior: When Codex changes files for a project, MIM records a project event with commit, files, validation, and remaining blocker.
When TOD accepts or rejects work, MIM records a project event.
When a project has no movement beyond seed/audit events, Studio marks it frozen or seed only.
When progress is estimated, planned, or evidence-backed, Studio says so directly.
